summary: The HTTP runtime slice now supports initialize/list/call behavior against a deterministic local harness and exposes a proxy-style Mu tool boundary.

findings.message: McpServerManager performs JSON-RPC initialize, tools/list, and tools/call requests over HTTP with explicit failure on non-OK responses.
The proxy tool converts Mu tool input into an MCP tool call and returns Mu-style content plus projection metadata.
The targeted suite proves connect/discover/call/degrade behavior plus a proxy-style Mu tool path against a deterministic local harness.
